title: Cadbury — A better ChatGPT for NetSuite questions
excerpt: Cadbury is an AI assistant custom-trained on expert NetSuite knowledge.
content_html:
Michael Chean

Groundwork Coffee

NetSuite documentation is dense, online help can be spotty, snarky, and sometimes slow. Cadbury has been an immense help, you can get process information, SuiteSQL, Suitescript and workflow answers right away. They still need to be checked of course, but the iterative process is quick and you get what you need. Highly recommend.
